description.en: An ICLR 2026 poster on joint audio-visual reasoning in Omni-LLMs, built with strict audio-video correlation across five cognitive dimensions and four audio information types. Because the question set requires both modalities, vendors that only report vision-only or audio-only figures are not comparable on this instrument. Automated annotation pipeline; manual verification effort is not quantified.
